bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to disaster relief; exempting Beltrami County from the cost-share requirement for state disaster assistance.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+NO LOCAL SHARE REQUIRED. +]

[+Notwithstanding the 25 percent applicant share required under Minnesota Statutes, section 12B.35, upon application and subject to the other requirements under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 12B, the commissioner of public safety must reimburse Beltrami County for 100 percent of eligible costs incurred by the county due to the severe storm event identified in Emergency Executive Order 25-06. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective retroactively from June 21, 2025. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to disaster relief; exempting Beltrami County from the cost-share requirement for state disaster assistance.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. NO LOCAL SHARE REQUIRED.

Notwithstanding the 25 percent applicant share required under Minnesota Statutes, section 12B.35, upon application and subject to the other requirements under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 12B, the commissioner of public safety must reimburse Beltrami County for 100 percent of eligible costs incurred by the county due to the severe storm event identified in Emergency Executive Order 25-06.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective retroactively from June 21, 2025.
additions: Notwithstanding the 25 percent applicant share required under Minnesota Statutes, section 12B.35, upon application and subject to the other requirements under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 12B, the commissioner of public safety must reimburse Beltrami County for 100 percent of eligible costs incurred by the county due to the severe storm event identified in Emergency Executive Order 25-06.
This section is effective retroactively from June 21, 2025.
